retrievalProfile.description: A centered studio portrait featuring a soft-lit subject against a neutral backdrop with large-scale serif typography spanning the top edge.
triggerTerms: muted pink and taupe studio photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A seated woman in a thoughtful pose, centered in the frame, wearing a halter top and long skirt. The lighting is diffused and warm, creating soft shadows. The color palette is dominated by muted taupe, dusty rose, and mauve. Large, elegant serif text is positioned at the very top, overlapping slightly with the subject's hair.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography anchored to the top margin
Color harmony between clothing and text
Soft-focus studio background blending with the subject's silhouette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large header, move down to the subject's face, then follow the arm down to the base of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left and right sides of the subject, creating a sense of calm.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mauve/Deep Pink (Text highlights and fabric patterns)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across all hues with mid-range values, creating a 'faded' vintage look.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking (touching or nearly touching)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters may overlap slightly to fit the width of the frame
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large serif display font paired with a tiny, delicate script or italic serif for secondary details.
graphicDevices: Thin white border framing the entire composition

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast, tight-kerning aesthetic of 70s display type.
Provides the characteristic 70s weight and serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman seated on the floor in a thoughtful pose, soft 1970s lighting, muted taupe background, wearing a dusty rose halter top and long skirt. Leave the top 20% of the frame clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large uppercase serif text in dusty rose at the top of the frame with extremely tight tracking, ensuring it spans the full width.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting soft and diffused?
Is the color palette muted and cohesive?
Is the typography large, serif, and tightly tracked?
Is there a thin white border around the image?

postGenerationChecks: Verify text overlaps or touches slightly
Ensure the border is thin and consistent
Confirm the subject's pose feels candid yet posed
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft Studio Portrait + High-Contrast Serif Header + Muted Rose/Taupe Palette + Tight Kerning
